authoringRules: Create BP_TraversalLink_Base and per-type Blueprint children from AJumanjiTraversalLink.
Place 12 link actors using the CSV as a first-pass greybox ledger.
Create BP_JumanjiLiftPlatform from AJumanjiLiftPlatform and place two platform actors.
Assign the matching lift platform reference to each Lift link.
Align lower/upper platform stops with the lift link entry/exit anchors.
Keep interaction focus volumes and lift boarding volumes query-only.
Do not treat the CSV coordinates as final collision-safe or NavMesh-safe positions.
Rebuild World Partition navigation data and validate both endpoints after terrain authoring.
